video_title: We DEBATE if The Cavaliers will EVER win with Donovan Mitchell getting paid a MAX contract 👀

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva argues Donovan Mitchell's defensive limitations hurt championship potential
quotes.excerpt: If you want to compete for a championship, you cannot pay him 75 million dollars.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: Donovan Mitchell deserves every dollar he is getting. I am not going to say he does not deserve it. That is the mistake I made by saying otherwise. What I believe is that if you want to compete for a championship, you cannot pay him 75 million dollars on average annually. He is your best player.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Why not? He is your best player.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: Because I think that type of money should only go to 10 people on earth. I don't know if he is a superstar. Every team is going to have a guy that gets that type of money and he is that guy on their team.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Every team is going to have a guy that gets that type of money and he is that guy on their team.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva debates if double-teaming Donovan Mitchell creates more open shots
quotes.excerpt: If you get triple-teamed and double-teamed more, are you going to have more open shots?

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: If you get triple-teamed and double-teamed more, are you going to have more open shots? Yes. That is my clearest point.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Harder, Donovan has gotten without his teammates.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: He is going to the finals, he is a champ.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: With a fucking team. And Donovan had a fucking team. Evan Mobley and James Harden.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva and Theo Pinson debate Donovan Mitchell's superstar status
quotes.excerpt: I don't think he can be the best player making 75, I think he needs to be closer to 55.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: He is saying he needs a better team and I am saying he does need a better team because I don't think he is great enough. I don't think he can be the best player making 75, I think he needs to be closer to 55 like Jalen Brunson did and take a discount to bring a player that is just as good beside him.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: So you are saying he needs to take a pay cut in order to get better.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: I am not saying that, I just don't think you will be able to contend for a championship if he is taking so much of your payroll. That is what I am saying.
